alignments.note: Verbless clause with no expressed subject; the supplied subject pronoun and copula ride with the predicate adjective (rule 68).
The ASV gives God no determiner, so the article carries nothing and the case preposition stays with the noun (rules 21, 23).
For a source noun rendered by of + noun, the noun is the head (rule 17).
The modal and the resumptive so are helpers on the lexical verb (rules 7, 9); reading so as added remains defensible.
The supplied complementizer belongs to the expanded non-finite complement (rule 85) and the supplied subject to the infinitive (rule 74).
No Greek preposition is expressed, so the supplied for is a helper on the participle (rule 7); doing realizes the verbal element of the compound (rule 17).
Parallel to well doing above: the supplied for is the participle's helper and doing is the head (rules 7, 17).
